description: Existing Hydropower Assets (EHA) Plant Database, 2022 is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The Existing Hydropower Assets (EHA) Plant Database is a point-level dataset with full geographic coverage containing locations and key characteristics of U.S. hydropower plants that are currently operational. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Water, Renewables, Electricity. Its keywords are existing assets, hydropower generation, market report. The portal shows 2024-07-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_domain). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
